answer_1.quote: The overarching objective of our work is to access the large body of domain-specific information available in Frequently Asked Question sites (FAQ for short) via conversational Question Answering (QA) systems.
answer_1.outputs: The system generates answers to conversational questions by extracting or rephrasing spans from FAQ passages, with dialogue acts such as affirmation and continuation.

answer_2.quote: F1 is the main evaluation metric and is computed by the overlap at word level of the prediction and reference answers.

answer_4.quote: In order to estimate the performance of a human in the task, we collected additional answers for the test splits for the three domains in a second round, after having completed the dialogues.
answer_4.guideline: Workers were shown the previous questions and answers in the dialogue (if available), and had to provide an answer span.
